title: The Borrow Checker as a Binary Auditor: Discovering Multi-Generation Android Firmware Defects via #![forbid(unsafe_code)] Safe Rust Reconstruction
description: Public research release and companion #![forbid(unsafe_code)] Safe Rust artifact (s9_camera_gyroscope) for 'The Borrow Checker as a Binary Auditor: Discovering Multi-Generation Android Firmware Defects via #![forbid(unsafe_code)] Safe Rust Reconstruction'. Demonstrates how compiling stripped aarch64 C/C++ vendor binaries into #![forbid(unsafe_code)] Safe Rust paired with 331,853-vector differential FFI parity testing acts as a deterministic vulnerability discovery oracle, uncovering 20 C/C++ defects (SAM-BUG-01 through SAM-BUG-20) and verifying their cross-generation survival from Android 10 (SM-G960U) into 2026 Android 16 flagships (SM-S938B and SM-S948B).
